source_section: ## SaaS och legacybank — evidensuppdatering utan poängändring, 2026-11-05

rubric.P_zero_when: Necessary real outcome is missing or required automation is paused.
rubric.score_9_5_requires: Critical acceptance met; no known blocking/serious defects; relevant production evidence; green final gates; correct deployed revision when applicable.

scoring_decision: 255 is an exact historical baseline, not a newly verified current product/live score. Missing live bank outcome and absent Bankgiro source require reassessing P. If P=0, area total cannot exceed 8; historical area 15 and area 17 scores of 8.5 therefore cannot be certified unchanged for that current scope. No complete new component assessment was conducted, so no exact replacement total is asserted. A subsequent narrow reassessment of fresh 17:15:28 UTC production-readonly evidence supports Gmail P=1 and backup P=1. Proposed 246 is provisional pending full component disclosure and exact-candidate final gates; it is not yet a certified total. Area 17 covers manual CSV/camt import, so source configuration alone is not the rationale for P=0.
evidence_scope: Read-only document, workflow and selected test-source review of 4ad205b; no suites run by this reviewer; no production write or provider request. Test file existence checked. Root reports main CI42059325916 green with 5702 tests; root new candidate a8dfcec tests and newly discovered consent defect are outside this reviewed commit.

candidate_unreviewed.status: Root final tests in progress at handoff; not reviewed or scored here.

current_reassessment.status: Provisionally defensible; final exact-SHA gates and explicit full five-component matrix still required.
current_reassessment.Gmail_scope: Current successful connection/fetch only; not externally verified schedule, complete OCR, or all registrations.
current_reassessment.backup_scope: Current complete manifest_pass outcome; not independently restored originals or complete API receipts.
current_reassessment.bankgiro_scope_correction: Manual CSV/camt import is part of criterion 17. Missing automated source alone cannot refute manual-import capability. P=0 is defensible because no authentic corporate report/import outcome is supplied.
required_conditions: All 33 F/S/K/U/P values must be explicit and sum exactly to each proposed score.
No reuse of full-suite green as blanket proof that every functional criterion is met.
Area 28 P=0 while required complete bank/OCR/external-schedule outcomes are absent.
P32=1 and the final grade remain provisional until exact candidate revision CI and final gates succeed.
No claim that the new candidate is deployed or production accepted merely because Sites62 succeeds.
